profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Perceptronics Solutions, Inc
profile.summary:
Information technology professional with significant experience in problem solving, leadership, and design and development of Java, Flutter/Dart, and Python technology solutions.  Recognized for creativity, research, willingness to teach and learn, and practical solutions to technical and business problems.  Motivated by opportunities to help businesses solve new problems in business and technology.

Currently looking for remote short- to medium-term contract work.

Java, Flutter/Dart, Python, Javascript, Docker, Springboot, SQL & NoSQL databases, Git w. git-flow, CI/CD (GitHub actions, Gitea actions, Gitlab, Jenkins).  Full-stack, front-end, back-end.  AI and other API's.

positions.title: Lead Production & Maintenance Engineer, Vice President
positions.description: Providing developer support to fix production issues on WF Commercial Lending web sites and web applications and microservices.  Leading efforts to update CI/CD footprint for all web apps and micro services.

positions.title: Technology Manager, Vice President
positions.description:
Created and lead a team of 6 engineers that develop and support applications and systems in support of the equity-trading function of WellsCap 24x7.  Key systems include Charles River Development (CRD) IMS for equity trading, several in-house developed JEE applications deployed on JBoss, and numerous small programs (Java, C#, etc.) deployed to support overnight and intraday batch processing.  Developed a team software-development methodology that is based on using best in class frameworks - JSF 2, Facelets, Primefaces, EJB 3.1, JPA (using Hibernate as the persistence engine), JBoss AS 7, Java 7, maven, Confluence for documentation, JIRA for issue and task definition, tracking and evolution

In December 2008 Wells Fargo purchased Wachovia (the parent company of Evergreen Investments).

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description: Worked as member of Architecture Team developing infrastructure and architectural level solutions and performing J2EE technology research for all development teams company-wide.  Provided internal consultation, design reviews, and troubleshooting to software development teams throughout the enterprise.  Serve as embedded developer for internal software projects as needed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Contractor
positions.description: Played a leading role in designing and developing a new enterprise-class architecture for Iron Mountain’s Digital-Assets archiving product. Duties and assignments included analysis of existing product (requirements, architecture, reverse engineering), design , development, and documentation of modern architecture for porting of legacy code , and development of code prototypes.  Technologies involved include JDK 1.4.2, JSP 1.2, Servlets 2.3, XML, XSL, Javascript, OOD, Ant, Struts 1.2.4, Spring 1.1.3, Spring AOP, Hibernate 2-3, Oracle 9i, Weblogic 8, Tomcat 5, etc.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description: Duties and assignments included design and development of Web Services and J2EE applications using the Oracle platform:  Oracle 9iAS, 10gAS, JDeveloper, 9i RDBMS, BC4J, Struts.  Other responsibilities include gathering requirements, writing white papers for technology comparisons and analyses.  Other technologies used include JDK 1.4.2, JSP, Servlets, XML, XSL, Javascript, Object-oriented design and development, Ant, CVS, Netbeans, Hibernate.

positions.title: Architect / Technical Lead - Contractor
positions.description: Architected and developed a survey website at MIT / LFE that is used to gather a variety of data for research purposes in the area of risk, decision-making, and factors involved with regards to equity trading.  This project was based  entirely on open-source technologies including Tomcat 4.1.X, JDK 1.4.X, MySQL 4.0.X, Apache 1.3.26, PHP 4.2.1, Struts 1.1, Castor JDO.  Team consisted of self, postdoc, and MIT Students at various levels in their master's-degree work.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer - Contractor
positions.description: Duties and assignments included development of web UI for mortgage-backed securities research system.  Technologies and platforms include JDK 1.3.1_08, Weblogic 7.0, internal MVC framework, Oracle 9i, JSP 1.1, Servlets 2.2, XML, XSL, Javascript, DHTML, Object-oriented design and development, Ant, CVS, Netbeans and Jbuilder , MS VSS.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description: Duties and assignments included development of Struts based web applications with extensive DHTML functionality.  Technologies and platforms include JDK 1.3.1_04, Tomcat 3.3.1-4.0.4, Struts 1.0.2-1.1(RC1), Oracle 8-9i, Websphere 4.0, JSP 1.1, Servlets 2.2, JAXP, XML, Javascript, DHTML, Object-oriented design and development, SQL, Forte 4J (EE and CE), CVS, MS VSS.
